resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts uses 'Tepee Point' in its page title, while firelookout.com and the Montana list use 'Teepee Point'. The story uses 'Teepee Point'.

notes_for_editor: Record height_m 6.0 and material wood come from OpenStreetMap tags (height=6, building:levels=2, tower:construction=wood). The page splits these across lines, so they are not quoted in facts; the editor may want to check the OSM tag units (metres assumed). Access and rental: none found in the pages read. A search summary pointed to a Forest Service map listing 'Tepee' as active and to McCart Lookout as a rental; neither was read or cited. Staffing names are omitted from the story. Read budget: 4 cached page reads (firelookout.com, Forest Lookouts, FFLA list, OSM), 1 WebSearch.
